description: K-fold fine-tune/eval split over the 12 female speakers, for fine-tuning the male-only-trained model (zero prior female exposure, confirmed against sex metadata) on women and localizing what changed. Each fold: 9 women fine-tune (never eval'd that fold), 3 women eval (never fine-tuned on that fold, and untouched by any gradient update in that fold's run). Every woman is in the eval role in exactly one fold. NOT a population claim -- fine-tune female n<=9, eval female n=3 per fold, within-sample.
n_flag: fine-tune female n<=9, eval female n=3 per fold -- within-sample, not a population claim
